record.body:
## Problem

`project:active-goal` has only `active -> superseded`. A finished effort stays active forever, so finished efforts crowd the handoff and the dashboard.

## Approach

Decide at plan-phase. Likely: a close transition on the goal (contract change in adaptive-artifacts or a project-level override), a close step when the last phase is done, and views that hide closed efforts.

## Exit criteria

Decide at plan-phase.
